name: Example Intent (starter template)
source: catalog starter set — copy this file per campaign intent
description: WHY this class of piece exists (e.g. reach, education, conversion, feature adoption, geo targeting).
success_metrics: the numbers that say it worked
cta_style: how the CTA sounds without breaking creator tone
pairs_well_with: hooks/formats this intent usually ships through
note: Intent = WHY the piece exists. Format = HOW it is made. Any intent can ship through any format.
